privacy.title: Privacy & opt-out
privacy.intro: Your details are personal data under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Here’s what we do with them.
points: We only collect what we need to answer your request: name, mobile number, and anything you choose to tell us.
We use it to call or message you about that request. We don’t sell it or share it with other dealers.
Our consultants see your details only for leads assigned to them or their showroom.
You can withdraw consent any time below. We’ll stop calls and messages for that number.
privacy.optSub: Enter the mobile number you gave us.
privacy.done: Done. We won’t contact this number again about past requests.
